verdict.rationale: Gitea ships its own CI/CD (Gitea Actions) and an official action runner you can deploy yourself, and lists Kubernetes AutoScaling Runners, so running pipelines on private runners is supported. There is no evidence of vendor-hosted runners: the managed offering is described only as a managed Gitea environment, not hosted compute for pipelines. Nothing documents a centralized view across runners. missing for 10: documented platform-hosted runners, centralized runner/pipeline visibility across fleets, runner registration and management docs, independent hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions runners.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run pipelines on platform-hosted runners or my own private runners with centralized visibility

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions.
We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
